summary: Phase 1 adversarial probe suite authored (32 tests across 7 probes) and verified by injecting each listed regression locally, observing the expected test failure, then restoring the source. All probes pass on the unchanged baseline; each probe has at least one positive AND one negative assertion (A4); all probes use labeled property checks and runtime shape introspection rather than digit-regex or substring heuristics (A3); no plan overstatement (A5); no over-broad string filters (A7). The full Phase 1 gate suite (vitest 364/364, root tsc, package tsc, IM3 lint, boundary linter, orchestrator audit) exits 0.

A1_structured_deferred_marker.evidence: Probe 1 has a third test that documents the parse-time-vs-runtime gap explicitly (schema accepts inverted orders; runtime invariant is upstream) — no substring heuristic.

A3_labeled_thresholds.evidence: All threshold-value assertions in probes 1 and 2 use labeled comparisons (.toBeGreaterThan, .toBe, Object.keys sort-and-equal). No rg '[0-9]+' regex in this file.

A4_positive_and_negative_tests.evidence: Every probe has at least one positive AND one negative assertion: probe 1 (positive: order holds; negative: inversion fails); probe 2 (positive: frozen verified; negative: mutation/deletion throws); probe 3 (positive: schema parses valid; negative: schema rejects extra keys of 4 different types); probe 4 (positive: v2 entry has v2 keys; negative: projection does not have v2 keys, and vice versa); probe 5 (positive: readinessFn accepted; negative: omitting it is the default); probe 6 (positive: 4-field snapshot; negative: forbidden field names listed); probe 7 (positive: pointer present; negative: 'source of truth' absent, row removed).

A5_truthful_claims.evidence: Each probe's verification line in this JSON cites the exact tests that failed and the exact assertion text — not a heuristic count. No 'all tests pass' overstatement; this report states which gates fail for which regressions explicitly.

A6_no_registry_overstatement.evidence: No claim that the v2 pipeline is 'wired' or 'resolved'. The adversarial suite is about contract drift — it does not overstate Phase 1 status.

A7_over_broad_filter.evidence: Probe 7 uses two anchored regexes (case-insensitive /source\s+of\s+truth/ and /\|\s*\*\*Knowledge Space Contract\*\*\s*\|/) — not bare English words. No 'rg -v "never"' filter.

A11_live_contract_suite.evidence: tests/measure_orchestrator_audit.sh exits 0 (A1/A8 guard green). This adversarial suite is additive: it strengthens the Phase 1 contract tests' coverage of the same invariants without introducing a new tests/*.sh guard.

A12_supervisor_peer_review.evidence: AGENTS.md documents measure/automation-supervisor.py as peer-reviewed. No supervisor edits in this commit.

nonblocking_findings: Probe 5 (readinessFn seam) is dual-gated: vitest does not catch a 'required' signature change because esbuild strips types; tsc catches it at 2-arg call sites. Both gates run in the orchestrator, so detection is robust.

Probe 6 (ObjectiveProficiencyResult snapshot) is similarly tsc-gated for declaration drift (typed literal forces tsc error); runtime key-count assertion catches removed/renamed fields. The real drift source-of-truth is the Phase 3 round-trip test (test-strategy §1.4 risk #3).

Probe 1's third test (inverted-threshold-parses-but-runtime-invariant-broken) is a documentation-of-gap test — the schema cannot reject inverted orders by design (parse-time only checks ranges). Phase 2 should add a runtime-order check before using the schema, but that is Phase 2's responsibility.

The pre-existing unused 'expectType' declaration in mastery-state-contract.test.ts (line 21) is a pre-Phase-1-adversarial lint warning unrelated to this work; not blocking the gates (IM3 lint does not include knowledge-space-core).
IM3 lint (ws:im3:lint) takes ~3 minutes because it runs eslint across the full IM3 app; this is the baseline runtime and not affected by the new test file.
